_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your décor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room! Can hold up to 15 pounds Fits standard interior walls Installation does require drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around 2 1/2" of hanging space All mounting hardware included Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in. title: Antique Pewter Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out, Wall Mount Brass - Carolina (Patent Pending), Allied Brass
description: Finished in Antique Pewter, retractable wall hook with 2-1/2" pull-out hanging space and wall-mount brass construction for bathroom coats, robes, and towels, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. Installs in standard interior walls using included toggle bolts; requires drilling a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around. Rod pulls out for use and pushes back in when not needed for a space-saving profile. Rated to hold up to 15 lb. Includes a removable knob tip that can be replaced with a cabinet knob of your choice to match existing hardware. Product size: 1.75" L x 1.75" H x 3.75" W; 1" projection. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass, Carolina collection.
